premises.text: Decades of daily blackouts force costly generators and disrupt homes and firms
premises.evidence_span: it costs four times the amount to run a backup generator than it costs to get power from the grid

premises.text: A software-hardware stack turns cheap Android phones into installed power sensors
premises.evidence_span: It's a software and hardware platform where we take low-cost Android phones

premises.text: Followed locations deliver outage/restore alerts via push or SMS and in-app outage reports
premises.evidence_span: for our users that don't have smartphones, they can use our platform using SMS as well

premises.text: Utilities buy the platform to talk directly to customers about outages
premises.evidence_span: power companies, and they can use our platform to communicate directly with their customers

value.text: Predictable awareness of when community power is available
value.evidence_span: let our users know when there's power available in their community

causal_links.evidence_span: push notification that the power has been restored
main customers are the power companies

notes: SMS and push treated as one notification channel premise. Market size and phone-penetration forecasts excluded as framing.
